Subject: Westrow Living Communities - Quote in Progress

Hi Tomas,

Thanks for the submission on Westrow Living Communities! I've received the application, statement of values, and loss runs—everything looks good to move forward.

I'm working on putting together a competitive quote for the December 16, 2026 effective date. I'll review the three locations and $17.7M total insured value and should have something back to you within the next few days.

I'll reach out if any questions come up during my review, but at this point we have what we need to proceed.

Thanks for thinking of us on this one!

Best regards,
[Underwriter name]
